facts.F1: Bug 6698, reported on Slack: When using the free version of Lighthouse, I am updating the definition of a team's workflow statuses. As I had documented those statuses elsewhere before, I have my list ready in a simple text file. Because I fear typos and uppercase/lowercase mismatches, I copy/paste them. Now, when I paste the status 'Waiting for Reproduction', it is not added but a different, previously added one (e.g. for another team) appears. Two examples of what was chosen instead of what I wanted: 'Waiting for Deployment' resp. 'Waiting for Approval'. This means I have to check the outcome of my insert in 'slightly paranoid mode'. The maintainer has seen the same or similar behaviour.
facts.F10: User hovers the suggestion Waiting for Deployment, then pastes Waiting for Reproduction and presses Enter
facts.F11: The list adds Waiting for Reproduction once
facts.F12: The pasted status is added, not another suggestion
facts.F13: Fix that ignores the highlight only for keyboard highlights, not mouse highlights
facts.F14: User moves the highlight with the arrow key, then types Waiting for Reproduction and presses Enter
facts.F15: The typed status is added, not another suggestion
facts.F16: Fix that clears the highlight only on paste, not on typing
facts.F17: User types Waiting for A, highlights with arrow key, presses Enter; separately types waiting for approval in lower case and presses Enter
facts.F18: The shown suggestion Waiting for Approval is added in both cases, with the suggestion's casing
facts.F19: Confirming a shown suggestion and case-insensitive matching still work
facts.F2: A state (or any list entry) that the user pastes or types and confirms with Enter is the one that gets added, never a different suggestion that was highlighted earlier.
facts.F20: Fix that never adds the highlighted option, adding typed text only (second case would still pass; first would not)
facts.F21: When the user pastes or types a value and presses Enter, the value added is the entered text (in a matching suggestion's casing when one matches it), or the suggestion the user picked for the text now in the input; a suggestion highlighted before the input changed is never added in its place.
facts.F22: When the user pastes or types a value with no suggestion picked for it and presses Enter, the value added is the text shown in the input; if a suggestion matches that text, the value added takes that suggestion's casing.
facts.F23: When the user has picked a suggestion for the text now in the input and presses Enter, the picked suggestion is the value added.
facts.F4: In a states list (and every other list built on ItemListManager), the user lets a suggestion become highlighted, then pastes or types a different value and presses Enter: the pasted or typed value is added, not the earlier highlighted suggestion.
facts.F5: Render the list with suggestions such as 'Waiting for Deployment' and 'Waiting for Approval'; open the suggestions and highlight 'Waiting for Deployment' with the mouse (and, in a second case, with the keyboard); then paste or type 'Waiting for Reproduction' and press Enter.
facts.F6: onAddItem is called once with 'Waiting for Reproduction'. A suggestion that the user highlights and confirms with Enter while it is still shown is still added as before, and a case-insensitive match of a typed value to a suggestion still takes the suggestion's casing.
facts.F7: onAddItem is called with 'Waiting for Deployment' (or any suggestion other than the one matching the entered text), or is not called at all.
facts.F9: A suggestion that was highlighted before the input changed is never added in place of the pasted or typed value.
